name: Section
description: Flexible mid-page content section: icon + eyebrow + title + description + buttons paired with a media gallery (images/videos) that becomes a Splide slider with more than one item. Media position, column split, text alignment, section background (color/image with overlay), aspect ratio, captions, and a full-screen lightbox are all configurable.
when_to_use: Narrative blocks like 'Our vision' or feature showcases with imagery. Use Hero for full-bleed openers, ImgSlider when the media row should dominate under a headline, River for alternating multi-row stories.
capabilities: media position left/right/top/bottom with narrow/normal/wide column split
gallery of images and videos; slider with arrows/pagination when >1 item
full-bleed section background: theme color or image with dark/light overlay
full-screen lightbox on click (Teleport modal, on by default)
caption below, overlaid, or hidden; section-wide aspect ratio presets

breakpoints.mobile: Layout stacks vertically regardless of media_position.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column split per media_position/media_width; top/bottom media spans full content width.

ai.prompt_summary: Section: text + media gallery section. Text: icon (Iconify, above eyebrow), eyebrow, eyebrow_decoration (none|bar|dot), eyebrow_color (7 semantic tokens), title (supports <strong> accent), description, buttons[] (shared Factory Button spec). Layout: media_position (right|left|bottom|top), media_width (narrow|normal|wide), content_align (left|center|right), text_max_width (narrow|normal|wide|full). Background: background_type (none|color|image), background_color (semantic token), background_image, background_overlay (none|dark|light). Media in media[]: { type (image|video), image, video, video_url, poster, alt, caption }; gallery-wide: aspect_ratio (auto|1/1|16/9|4/3|3/2|21/9|3/4|2/3), caption_position (below|overlay|none), show_arrows, show_pagination, enable_lightbox.
ai.content_guidelines: One <strong> emphasis per title at most. Description 2-4 sentences. Captions short enough to overlay. Do not stack two Sections with the same background color.

field_hints.background_color: Semantic theme token, never a hex value; only read when background_type is color.
field_hints.media: More than one item turns the gallery into a slider.
field_hints.enable_lightbox: On by default — clicking media opens a full-screen modal.
field_hints.media_width: Only applies when media is left/right of the text.
